items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Zutty was in there, Al Morgan.

ctx.x: Vernon Andrade. Most of them -- the rest of -- the piano player, he was from Panama. They all went to school down in Louisiana, and (unintelligible) went to the little laboratory, to the school there in Atlanta, Georgia. See, most of them fellows come from the islands -- like Spanish, like Panama and Cuba. They come and join the band.
I see. Yeah, well, it just seems to be that that band, that would be able to -- I mean was Zuffy in that band?
Zutty was in there, Al Morgan.
